messages:
Alex K: Quick design check — attaching a mock of the compare view. When you enter compare mode we collapse filters into a left 'shelf' panel. Is the affordance clear? i'm worried the pin action reads like a delete. https://imgur.com/mock123 Kai - Design: I like the shelf. Two quick asks: change the pin icon (current glyph looks like a filled droplet) to a standard pin outline + add a short label 'Pin version'. Tooltip should read: 'Pin version for this comparison'. Also add a keyboard hint (e.g. 'press P to pin'). Maria S: Accessibility note — the pin must be an aria-pressed toggle and have a visible focus ring. Screen readers should announce something like 'Pinned, version 1.3'. Let's plan an NVDA/VoiceOver pass after the iteration. Samir: Regarding performance badges — green/red feels binary. Suggest neutral slate color with a small semantic icon (bolt for throughput, clock for latency) and show p50/p95 in the hovercard. Example hover text: 'Latency • p50 120ms / p95 320ms'. Kai - Design: Agree on neutral color. My proposal: amber only for high variance warnings. Microcopy for badges: 'Latency (p50 / p95)'. Do we want inline numbers in the compare table or only on hover? I lean inline for the sparse compare mode. Diane (PM): Inline numbers are better for quick scans, but for small screens we should collapse to tooltip under 720px. Also decision on wording: 'Lock version' vs 'Pin version'? I'd vote 'Pin version' — users understand 'pin' in this context. Alex K: Good call on 'Pin version'. One more thing — when you pin a version in compare it currently affects other product views which surprised support. Can we add helper microcopy under the pin: 'Pins apply to this comparison only' and a toast that says 'Version pinned for this comparison.' Maria S: Yes, add the helper text and ensure the toast uses role='status' so screen readers announce it. Example:
Version pinned for this comparison.
. Also ensure the helper text has sufficient contrast. ui-bot: a11y-lint: Badge label contrast fails on small text (WCAG AA). Recommend increasing weight or changing color to meet 3:1 ratio. Samir: UX nit — when pinning an older model, show an 'outdated' pill: 'Not latest • pinned to 2025-11-01' with tooltip explaining why pinned. This avoids surprise when results differ from prod. Kai - Design: I'll sketch an iteration and open a small PR: - swap icon to pin outline + explicit 'Pin version' button - helper copy: 'Pins are per-comparison' beneath the control - inline p50/p95 in compact compare, tooltip for mobile - neutral badge colors + amber for variance - include 'outdated' pill for pinned non-latest versions. Will tag for review and include a11y checklist. Alex K: :thumbsup: thanks! Can folks review the PR when it's up? cc @Diane (PM) @Maria S
